name: UIZZE — Stop UI Slop
tagline: Stop Cline from shipping the same generic UI again
description: A free UI finish-gate workflow for Cline that forces product-specific design contracts, required interaction states, existing design-system reuse, rendered inspection, and a hard pre-ship review instead of accepting interchangeable card grids and happy-path mockups. The optional full UIZZE MCP adds live UI-reference search across 800,000+ real web and iOS screens, validation, audits, and rendered critique.
